items: Write Base Styles: Create CSS for mobile (smallest screen size) without media queries.
Add Media Queries with min-width: Use media queries to enhance the design for tablets, desktops, and larger screens.

blocks.content: This setup starts with a simple design for mobile and progressively adds styles for larger screens.
